name: dumbbell rdl stretch
description: Holding the bottom of a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells. It loads the hamstrings in their stretched position.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold the position with a flat back.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then stand up.
